purpose: Find a context where the LEARNED incumbent G0 genuinely fails. Replaces scripted-probe-based context selection.

incumbent.name: G0
incumbent.description: frozen 1M piR family, used as incumbent generalist (NOT 'the RUSH specialist')

pairing: All three G0 seeds see the identical evaluation seed block within an opponent, so seed-paired CIs are valid.
ranking_rule: W(c) = max over G0 seeds of payoff(G0_s, c); LOWER is a better weakness. Using the max prevents selecting a context that only defeats one weak member of the incumbent family.
weakness_gate: All three G0 seeds have negative mean margin AND the family-level upper CI95 is below zero. If nothing qualifies, select nothing.
